description: The explicit component-inclusion matrix, confirmed by inspecting exporters/selection.py, preview/mesh.py, and exporters/specification.py directly during Sprint 7.

notes.JSON: The JSON export is the canonical JewelryDefinition itself, not a geometry export — 'component inclusion' does not apply the same way. Every field (including stone.diameter/depth) is present as design metadata, never as a fused/compound geometric component.
notes.TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION: Includes per-component volumes for band/prongs/basket_support and the combined metal volume (build_specification() in exporters/specification.py); includes the stone's diameter/depth as design metadata under a heading explicitly labeled '(reference only, not a gemological reproduction)', never as production metal.
notes.stone_reference: Never 'prohibited' for any artifact type — always at least optionally includable (STEP/STL via includeStoneReference=true) or already included as metadata (JSON, spec) or always visible (preview). No artifact type excludes it unconditionally.
